blocker.summary: The r399-r452 chain is closed (SIGSEGV fixed by launching against the real ISO instead of the incomplete assets/ directory, r452, verified reproducibly, no source change). r453 quantified the impact: a full VD-traced 25s probe against the real ISO captured 86 real draw calls, versus 0-1 per present in every capture from r425 through r450. Five clean presents at 1280x720, clean thread termination confirmed a third time. The fix doesn't just remove the crash -- it unblocks substantially richer content processing, consistent with the whole r399-r451 causal chain (the game can now actually read and use real PAC content instead of silently failing on missing data). Not yet established: whether this content is actually rendered to visible pixels -- PinnedShaderRuntime is still never wired to the live VdSwap path (r434/r435/r438, unaffected by this fix). Named for r454: resume that visual-content thread, now much better justified since there's real data to render, not just a hypothesis. Still open, non-blocking: updating tools/prepare.py/build.py to default to the current ISO path (convenience, not necessity); the native_vulkan_backend.cpp backlog commit decision (r433/r434/r438), unrelated to this fix.
